questions.scenario: Your group has to present a massive project next week. What role do you naturally take?

options.text: Guessing what questions the teacher will ask based on past years and preparing answers.
Keeping all the project files, charts, and materials organized so nothing gets lost.
Creating a strict timeline and assigning specific tasks to each member to ensure we finish on time.
Reviewing the whole project to find faster, easier ways to get the same amount of marks.

questions.scenario: You are packing your bags for a 5-day family vacation. How do you approach it?

options.text: I check the weather forecast for the whole week so I pack exactly what is needed, no more, no less.
I neatly roll and organize my clothes so everything fits perfectly into the suitcase without wasting space.
I plan a daily itinerary of what I'm wearing on Monday, Tuesday, etc., and pack in that order.
I try to figure out how to pack everything into a single small backpack to avoid paying for extra luggage.

questions.scenario: Your school is hosting a massive carnival. What is your main concern?

options.text: Trying to estimate exactly how many students will buy tickets so we don't order too much food.
Guarding the storage room to make sure supplies are safe and aren't being wasted by volunteers.
Making sure the DJ, the food stalls, and the games all start at the exact scheduled times.
Noticing that the entry line is too long and figuring out a way to speed up the ticket checking.

questions.scenario: How do you usually study for your final exams?

options.text: I analyze the last 5 years of question papers to predict which topics will definitely come.
I organize all my notes, pens, and textbooks perfectly on my desk before I can even start reading.
I create a strict timetable: 1 hour for Math, 10 minute break, 1 hour for Science.
I find a YouTube video that explains a boring 3-hour chapter efficiently in just 15 minutes.

questions.scenario: You are playing a strategy or simulation video game (like Minecraft, Clash of Clans, or a Tycoon game). What’s your favorite part?

options.text: Predicting what the enemy or the market will do next and preparing my defenses early.
Managing my inventory, chest boxes, or backpack so I always know where my items are.
Queuing up buildings and upgrades in a specific order so they finish exactly when I need them.
Calculating the exact stats to build the absolute most efficient character or base.

questions.scenario: If you are put in charge of doing the groceries for your house, how do you handle it?

options.text: I look at what we ran out of last month to predict exactly what we need to buy this month.
I make sure everything is put away in the fridge and pantry perfectly so nothing gets squashed.
I walk through the supermarket aisles in a very specific order so I don't waste time going back and forth.
I compare the 'price-per-gram' of different brands to ensure we get the absolute best deal.

questions.scenario: When you and your friends go out to eat, what is most likely to annoy you?

options.text: When people order way too much food and half of it goes to waste.
When the table is cluttered with empty plates and glasses that the waiter hasn't cleared.
When the food takes forever to arrive and ruins our plans for the rest of the evening.
When we take a terrible route to get to the restaurant and get stuck in traffic.

questions.scenario: Your Wi-Fi suddenly goes down while you have pending homework. What is your reaction?

options.text: I already downloaded the PDF notes yesterday because I knew this might happen.
I switch to organizing my backpack and cleaning my room until the internet comes back.
I quickly shift my schedule around and do the offline homework first, delaying the online tasks.
I instantly log into the router settings or call the ISP to find the root cause of the problem.

questions.scenario: What kind of YouTube video or reel are you most likely to watch?

options.text: A video predicting future technology trends or what the world will look like in 2050.
A satisfying video of a messy room or dirty car being perfectly cleaned and organized.
A 'Day in the Life' vlog showing a highly productive person's morning routine.
A documentary explaining how companies like Amazon deliver millions of packages so fast.

questions.scenario: If you could instantly download a new superpower into your brain, what would it be?

options.text: The ability to accurately see up to 7 days into the future.
The ability to instantly organize any space by snapping my fingers.
The ability to freeze time so I can finish everything perfectly on my schedule.
The ability to see floating numbers that tell me the fastest, smartest way to solve any problem.

Demand_Planner.title: Demand Planner / Forecaster
Demand_Planner.primary_match_text: You are a visionary who loves looking ahead. You are great at spotting patterns, predicting what will happen next, and making sure everyone is prepared for the future.
Demand_Planner.day_in_the_life: Analyzing market trends and past sales data to predict exactly how many new iPhones or sneakers a company needs to manufacture so they never run out of stock.
Demand_Planner.alternative_match_text: Because you are great at predicting trends and avoiding shortages, forecasting consumer demand is a fantastic alternative career path.
Demand_Planner.roadmap: Take Commerce (with Math) or Science in 11th/12th. Pursue a degree in Statistics, Economics, or a BBA, followed by an MBA or certification in Supply Chain Planning.

Inventory_Manager.title: Inventory & Stock Manager
Inventory_Manager.primary_match_text: You are the ultimate organizer. You hate clutter, love knowing exactly where things are, and ensure that space and resources are never wasted.
Inventory_Manager.day_in_the_life: Managing massive warehouses for companies like Flipkart or Nike, ensuring millions of products are safely stored, tracked, and ready to be shipped at a moment's notice.
Inventory_Manager.alternative_match_text: Since you are highly organized and hate wasting resources, keeping track of multimillion-dollar corporate inventory is a strong backup plan.
Inventory_Manager.roadmap: Take Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, or Retail Management to master warehouse operations.

Production_Planner.title: Production Scheduler
Production_Planner.primary_match_text: You are a master of time management. You know how to break down massive tasks into step-by-step plans and ensure everything happens in perfect order.
Production_Planner.day_in_the_life: Coordinating giant manufacturing factories (like a Tesla gigafactory), ensuring that machines, raw materials, and workers are perfectly scheduled to build products on time.
Production_Planner.alternative_match_text: If you love making schedules and coordinating complex tasks, planning the production lines for major factories is a highly rewarding option.
Production_Planner.roadmap: Take Science (PCM) or Commerce in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Tech in Industrial/Mechanical Engineering or a BBA in Operations Management.

Supply_Chain_Analyst.title: Supply Chain Analyst
Supply_Chain_Analyst.primary_match_text: You are a natural problem solver and optimizer. You love looking at complex systems, finding bottlenecks, and figuring out the fastest, cheapest, and smartest way to do things.
Supply_Chain_Analyst.day_in_the_life: Using advanced software and data to figure out the cheapest and fastest routes for cargo ships and airplanes to transport goods across the globe.
Supply_Chain_Analyst.alternative_match_text: With your analytical brain and desire for efficiency, using data to solve global shipping problems is a perfect alternative career for you.
Supply_Chain_Analyst.roadmap: Take Science or Commerce (with Math) in 11th/12th. Pursue a B.Sc/B.Tech in Data Science, Mathematics, or a specialized degree in Supply Chain Analytics.
